title: Author the prompt-writing standard as a doctrine-layer knowledge doc
action: Per prompt-diet D5 as AMENDED by plan.md Constraints (no size ceilings - decision 8f63adb4 / budget-fence-removal D1/D6). Author docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/prompt-writing-standard.md following the area-doc format of the two read_first doctrine docs (frontmatter: type bee.area, bee.id, lifecycle active, areas [doctrine-layer], required_context [areas/doctrine-layer/overview.md], decisions and sources citing prompt-diet CONTEXT.md and the four studies: Lulla 2601.20404, ETH SRI 2602.11988, Khatri 2607.27250, NAIST 2511.12884). Content - the standard for writing or editing any bee instruction text (AGENTS block, SKILL.md, references, agent files): (a) the four-question line filter (self-discoverable? what concrete costly behavior does its absence cause? verifiable? conflicts with another line?) grounded in the research: instructions are followed at roughly 100x the rate when stated (ETH tool-mention data), overview prose shows no measurable steering effect, every line costs (+20-23 percent inference across agents); (b) add-on-failure, never add-upfront: a line earns its place when the same failure occurred twice, a review caught what the text should have prevented, or the same correction was typed in two sessions; (c) one rule, one home: generalize the existing duplication boundary (cite router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md, rule R4) from router-vs-operating-block to EVERY instruction document - a boundary rule is stated in full once, everywhere else a one-line cite plus local delta; presence-pinned strings may gain occurrences but never be reworded; (d) verifiable-imperative style: commands with arguments over adjectives; (e) deterministic backstop preference: an absolute MUST or NEVER belongs in a hook or permission when structurally reachable, markdown carries only what enforcement cannot reach - cite unenforced-obedience.md ONLY after reading it and confirming its content matches; (f) explicitly record: no standing size ceiling exists or may be introduced (cite budget-fence-removal); density is judged per edit; a diet is a one-off event and prompt-diet is one such event. Add one row to docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/index.md matching its existing format. Every citation must name a real file and real heading (pointer_integrity enforces).

truths: prompt-writing-standard.md exists in area-doc format with resolving citations
